title: Target Date to Revise Penalties for Animal Cruelty and Introduce Failure in Duty of Care Provisions
what_it_is: Target Date to Revise Penalties for Animal Cruelty and Introduce Failure in Duty of Care Provisions

sections.label: Animal welfare review and Code
sections.summary: The review covers animal disease, veterinary products, animal welfare penalties and enforcement, with NParks consulting stakeholders and the Code setting minimum standards.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: As highlighted in the reply to Mr Louis Ng on a similar Parliamentary Question last November and the recent update at the Committee of Supply debate in response to a cut by Mr Henry Kwek last month, the review covers several areas, including the regulatory framework for the prevention and control of animal diseases and veterinary health products, the penalty framework for animal welfare offences and enforcement powers for animal welfare and management.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: NParks has been conducting small group discussions with relevant stakeholders and incorporating their inputs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: NParks intends to conduct consultations with more stakeholders this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The Code of Animal Welfare (for the Pet Industry) specifies minimum standards and best practices for animal housing, management and care to safeguard the health and welfare of animals.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Failure to comply to the minimum standards in the Code may be used as supporting evidence for prosecution.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: To date, non-compliance with the minimum standards in the Code has not been used as evidence to support prosecution, as the evidence gathered in cases that proceeded to prosecution was sufficient.

sections.label: NParks spot checks
sections.summary: NParks will do spot checks on some places as part of its licensing framework and regulatory ambit.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: NParks, as part of its broader licensing framework and regulatory ambit, will do spot checks and take a look at some of these places.

sections.label: Licensing and enforcement powers
sections.summary: The licensing framework, enforcement powers and various regulatory levers are also being looked at.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: As part of that, we are also looking at the licensing framework and the enforcement powers and the various regulatory levers.
